data.name: Mustansar
data.gender_notes: Mustansar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'istansar', meaning 'to support' or 'to strengthen'. In Islamic history, Mustansar is the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his unwavering support and strength during battles. The name Mustansar carries the meaning “Support, Strength” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mustansar usually hope their child will grow to embody support, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes unwavering support and strength in faith.
data.etymology: Mustansar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, Strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustansar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
